title: Text: DET Chad Crunk ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Anthony, just confirming you’re not going to be in Chicago? Also, your Chippewas are taking it to my wildcats today
I don’t think so. If I do it will be last minute. What’s the score
UK scored late in the first half to take a 21-20 lead at halftime. Good game though. Enjoy the time away
